protocol.gate_def: sigmoid of the real gate_low/gate_mid/gate_high outputs, 448 channels averaged per point
protocol.wall_dist_def: distance to the nearest sampled boundary point (first 660 points, cKDTree k=1); boundary points are 0; not exact continuous wall distance
protocol.vorticity_def: |dv/dx - du/dy| from reference u,v, kNN local linear fit
protocol.gradT_def: ||grad T|| from reference T, kNN local linear fit
